title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows: shared meeting timer from the room console
notes: claim 39: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the page assumes the timer will appear without an administrator enabling it, although its default is not published, and overstates licensing as the only available lever. It also tells readers to wait for a Pro licence price that Microsoft already publishes; the roadmap facts and licence inventory instructions are supported.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The cited Teams Rooms licences and home-screen documentation pages do not publish the Pro licence price.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro license price meeting timer pricing. Read learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/rooms-licensing and mtr-home-refresh in full: no Pro price appears there. Microsoft's separate compare-rooms-plans page does publish a price.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Why it matters; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No separate timer-specific meter or price is published.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro license price meeting timer pricing; Teams Rooms timer price. Read rooms-licensing and microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-teams/microsoft-teams-rooms/compare-rooms-plans pricing text; neither gives a timer-specific price or meter.

claims.claim: Basic-licensed room entitlement to this timer is not stated beyond the roadmap's Pro licence wording.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms timer; Teams Rooms Pro license price meeting timer pricing. Read roadmap and rooms-licensing comparison tables; the roadmap says Available with a Teams Rooms Pro license, and the tables contain no timer.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a required app version for this timer.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Windows meeting timer countdown admin settings default version license audit logs; shared meeting countdown timer rollout version start pause resume cancel. Read roadmap, mtr-home-refresh and rooms-release-note search excerpts; no timer version stated.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published rollout mechanics or a release channel for this timer.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms shared meeting countdown timer audit records retention roles rollout version start pause resume cancel. Read roadmap and mtr-home-refresh; release-note excerpts describe other updates, not this timer's rollout or channel.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published feature-specific configuring roles or meeting-role restrictions on starting this timer.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms shared meeting countdown timer audit records retention roles rollout version start pause resume cancel. Read roadmap, mtr-home-refresh and pro-portal-settings; generic Rooms Management permissions do not establish roles for an undocumented timer control.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout, first bullet
claims.claim: The Pro Management portal Rooms and Inventory views expose device licensing status in the License Type column.
claims.quote: Use your credentials to log into the Pro Management Portal. Go to Rooms and Inventory views. In both views, locate the License Type column to see device licensing status.

claims.claim: The room licence is assigned to the room account.
claims.quote: This will allow you to assign the new license to your existing resource accounts, allow 24 hours, and then remove the legacy license from the accounts.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support, second bullet
claims.claim: The room's licence is the only lever administrators have before the timer arrives.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms meeting timer PowerShell Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy XML configuration timer. Read pro-portal-settings, mtr-home-refresh; searched device-settings-available, xml-config-file and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy. No source states licensing is the only possible lever.
claims.fix: Replace the bullet with: 'Microsoft has not documented a timer-specific admin setting as of November 2026; the roadmap states that the timer is available with a Teams Rooms Pro licence.'

claims.claim: Administrators should plan on the feature appearing in Pro-licensed rooms without an admin switch.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Windows meeting timer countdown admin settings default version license audit logs; Teams Rooms countdown. Read roadmap and mtr-home-refresh. Neither states whether the feature appears automatically or requires enabling.
claims.fix: Replace the paragraph with: 'Microsoft has not stated what happens on arrival. Confirm the timer's default and any admin setting against Message center and Microsoft Learn when feature-specific guidance is published.'

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout, second bullet
claims.claim: The Pro licence cost must wait until it is published before it can inform an upgrade decision.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro ... $40.00 ... room/month, paid yearly ... (Annual subscription-auto renews)
claims.fix: Replace 'and put the licence cost, once published, into that decision' with 'and use the published Pro licence price or your organisation's contracted price in that decision'. Cite https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-teams/microsoft-teams-rooms/compare-rooms-plans.

claims.claim: The timer is visible only when someone starts one.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms timer; Teams Rooms countdown. Read roadmap and mtr-home-refresh. The record documents starting a timer from the console but does not state that no timer UI appears before starting or that every timer must be manually started.
claims.fix: Replace the impact rationale with: 'Low. The roadmap describes a countdown shown on the front-of-room display and in participants' meeting views, with timer actions available from the room console.'
